title: A case closure is traceable from trigger to evidence to outcome
risk: A closed case cannot be explained later, so the business cannot prove what the customer was told or whether the promise was kept.
preconditions: A case for cust-a resolved with refund_approved and linked to ORD-A-1 in namespace cd-trace-*
Traceability query executed for the case at 2026-01-16T12:00:00Z

steps.action: Traverse the case traceability chain from the trigger to the outcome
steps.expected: each hop resolves to a concrete record id and the chain is unbroken end to end

steps.action: Verify the evidence record backing the resolution
steps.expected: the evidence record carries a provider or system reference and its own identifier, and resolves to ORD-A-1

steps.action: Attempt to close a second case without linking any evidence record
